info.headline: Heavy Rain Risk Area
info.description:
Another high-pressure system from China extended to the upper North and the upper Northeast while the easterly wind and the southeasterly wind bring moisture from the South China Sea to the eastern part of the Northeast and the East. Meanwhile, the monsoon trough lies across the Gulf and the South.
More rains and variable weather with thundershower, gust wind, hail and isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall including lightning strike are likely in the upper country while isolated heavy rains remains in the South. After that less rain are possible in the upper North and the upper Northeast.
The Andaman Sea and the Gulf, waves will be higher than 2 meters high in thundershower areas.
info.instruction:
People should beware of severe conditions with heavy to very heavy rainfalls and accumulations that may cause flash flood and overflows, especially along the waterways near foothills and lowlands.
All ships should keep off thundershowers.
